Hello!

Due to some RL stuff I had to stop working on this for a while. Anyway, Big thanks to Kuroinu Juu for his always amazing work, to Sebo70 for the scans and to Doujins.com for the translation. This one has become kinda one of my fave books from this author.

Next... well, I sill don't know. Have to decide between starting work on decesoring a new Kuroinu Juu doujin or finishing some old Hellabuna books I just managed to recover from a damaged drive.

Have fun.
